display_long_description:
SPACES by IAMVERSE is a social VR world where people come together to connect, unwind, and share unforgettable moments. It's a place built for belonging — somewhere you can step away from the everyday and enjoy the company of others, wherever they may be.

Make it yours Design an avatar that feels like you, then watch it come to life with natural, expressive movement that makes every interaction feel warm and genuine.

Conversations that feel real Immersive voice makes every friend sound close enough to touch. Gather your circle, introduce yourself to a stranger, and watch acquaintances blossom into lasting friendships.

Always something to discover Play through a world of interactive experiences, enjoy shared screens and live shows with friends, or step into vibrant gatherings and events hosted across stunning virtual venues.

A stage for everyone SPACES makes hosting effortless. Welcome your guests, take the spotlight, and create an atmosphere where everyone feels included.

Your space to belong Meet new people, build your community, and create memories that last. Step inside and discover where SPACES will take you — your next friendship is only a moment away.
